title: Tiredness

questions.question: Do you often feel tired?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I do sometimes, especially in the middle of the week, because my schedule is quite busy. I usually try to catch up on sleep at the weekend.

questions.question: When would you feel tired?
questions.sampleAnswer: I tend to feel tired after a long day of classes or after staying up late. It usually happens when I haven’t had enough sleep or I’ve been staring at screens for hours.

questions.question: What do you do when you feel tired?
questions.sampleAnswer: What I usually do is take a short nap or go for a walk to refresh myself. I also tend to make a cup of tea and listen to music to help me relax.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: My weekly schedule is quite hectic, so I usually try to catch up on sleep at the weekend.

vocabulary.term: in the middle of the week
vocabulary.exampleSentence: I tend to hit a productivity wall especially in the middle of the week.
Staring at computer screens for hours without breaks inevitably strains my eyes.
Taking a ten-minute brisk walk outdoors helps refresh myself after intense work.
What I usually do is take a short power nap to recharge my energy.
